ha.title: Niyya da Faɗin Bismillah
ha.desc: Yana niyya a zuciyarsa don ɗauke hadasi (ba a furta niyya da baki), kuma yana ambaton sunan Allah (Bismillah) lokacin farawa.

ha.title: Kurkure Baki da Shaƙa Ruwa a Hanci
ha.desc: Yana kurkure bakinsa yana shaƙa ruwa a hancinsa, sannan ya fyace shi, yana yin haka sau uku, yana haɗa kurkure baki da shaƙa ruwa.

ha.title: Wanke Fuska
ha.desc: Yana wanke fuskarsa sau uku, a tsawo daga tsirowar gashin kai har ƙarshen haɓa, a faɗi kuma daga kunne zuwa kunne.

ha.title: Wanke Hannaye zuwa Gwiwar Hannu
ha.desc: Yana wanke hannayensa har zuwa gwiwar hannu sau uku, na dama sannan na hagu.

ha.title: Shafar Kai da Kunnuwa
ha.desc: Yana shafar kansa duka sau ɗaya, yana farawa daga gaban kai zuwa ƙeya, sannan ya dawo da hannayensa baya, sannan ya shafi kunnuwansa.

ha.title: Wanke Ƙafafu zuwa Idon Sawu
ha.desc: Yana wanke ƙafafunsa har zuwa idon sawu sau uku, na dama sannan na hagu, yana tsefe tsakanin yatsun ƙafa da yatsunsa.

ha.title: Addu'a Bayan Alwala
ha.desc: Idan ya gama alwalarsa, yana faɗin zikirin da aka ruwaito.

ha.title: Kabbarar Harama (Takbiratul-Ihram)
ha.desc: Yana fuskantar alƙibla ya yi niyyar sallar a zuciyarsa, sannan ya ɗaga hannayensa daidai da kafaɗunsa ya yi kabbara (Allahu Akbar).

ha.title: Addu'ar Buɗe Sallah (Du'a al-Istiftah)
ha.desc: Yana ɗora hannunsa na dama a kan na hagu a ƙirjinsa, sannan ya karanta addu'ar buɗe sallah a asirce.

ha.title: Neman Tsari da Basmala
ha.desc: Yana neman tsari daga Shaiɗan (Ta'awwuzi) kuma yana faɗin Basmala a asirce kafin ya karanta Al-Fatiha.

ha.title: Karanta Al-Fatiha
ha.desc: Yana karanta Surar Al-Fatiha, wadda rukuni ce a kowace raka'a, sannan ya karanta abin da ya sauƙaƙa daga Alƙur'ani a raka'o'i biyu na farko, kuma bayanta yana cewa: Amin.

ha.title: Ruku'u da Tasbihinsa
ha.desc: Yana ɗaga hannayensa, ya yi kabbara, ya yi ruku'u, yana ɗora tafukan hannayensa a gwiwoyinsa yana daidaita bayansa, kuma yana tasbihi ga Allah sau uku.

ha.title: Ɗagowa daga Ruku'u
ha.desc: Yana ɗago kansa, yana ɗaga hannayensa shi ma, yana faɗin tasmi'i (Sami' Allahu liman hamidah), kuma idan ya tsaya daidai, yana faɗin tahmidi (Rabbana wa lakal-hamd).

ha.title: Sujada da Tasbihinta
ha.desc: Yana kabbara ya yi sujada a kan gaɓoɓi bakwai (goshi da hanci, tafukan hannaye biyu, gwiwoyi biyu, da kan yatsun ƙafafu), yana tasbihi ga Allah sau uku, kuma yana yawaita addu'a.

ha.title: Zama Tsakanin Sujada Biyu
ha.desc: Yana ɗagowa daga sujada yana kabbara, ya zauna a zaman iftirashi, ya yi addu'a, sannan ya yi sujada ta biyu kamar ta farko.

ha.title: Tahiyya (Tashahhud)
ha.desc: Bayan raka'o'i biyu na farko da kuma a ƙarshen sallah, yana zama don tashahhud, yana nuni da yatsansa manuni, kuma yana karanta tahiyyat.

ha.title: Salatin Ibrahimiyya (As-Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah)
ha.desc: A tashahhud na ƙarshe, yana yin salati ga Annabi ﷺ, sannan ya yi addu'a da abin da ya so kafin taslimi (sallamar ƙarshe).

ha.title: Sallama (Taslimi)
ha.desc: Yana kammala sallah da sallama, yana juyawa dama sannan hagu.
